instructions:
1. Set both pulleys to the highest position and attach a handle to each.
2. Stand in the center, grasp a handle in each hand with palms facing forward.
3. Step forward with one foot, keep your back straight and arms out to the sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
4. Pull the handles down and inward until they meet in front of your hips.
5. Slowly return your arms to the starting position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your chest as the handles meet in front of your hips.
2. Keep the elbow bend fixed so the chest does the work, not the arms.
3. Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return.
4. Use a weight that lets you control the full range of motion.

instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to the high pulley and grasp it shoulder-width with palms facing down.
2. Stand facing the machine, feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
3. Lean your torso slightly forward, keep your back straight and arms extended at shoulder height.
4. Keep your arms straight and pull the bar down to your thighs in an arc.
5. Slowly return the bar to shoulder height with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms straight so the lats drive the movement.
2. Brace your core to keep your torso stable.
3. Squeeze your lats as the bar reaches your thighs.
4. Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return.

instructions:
1. Attach an EZ bar to the high pulley and grasp it with both hands.
2. Turn so your back faces the machine, feet in a staggered stance.
3. Step forward to create tension and extend your arms overhead, elbows close to your ears.
4. Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms still.
5. Extend your arms back overhead with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms still and close to your ears.
2. Brace your core to protect your lower back from overextending.
3. Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
4. Exhale as you extend, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Attach a V-bar to the high pulley and grasp it with both hands, palms facing each other.
2. Stand facing the machine, feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
3. Lean slightly forward with a straight back and bend your elbows to about 90 degrees, flared out to the sides.
4. Push the bar down to your thighs by straightening your elbows.
5. Slowly return to the starting position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your triceps at the bottom of each rep.
2. Keep your torso steady and avoid leaning into the bar.
3. Use a moderate weight to protect your elbow joints.
4. Exhale as you push down, inhale as you return.

instructions:
1. Attach an EZ bar to the high pulley and grasp it shoulder-width with palms facing down.
2. Stand facing the machine, feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
3. Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with your upper arms close to your body.
4. Push the bar down to your thighs by straightening your elbows.
5. Slowly return to the starting position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms pinned to your sides throughout.
2. Squeeze your triceps at the bottom of each rep.
3. Keep your torso steady and avoid using momentum.
4. Exhale as you push down, inhale as you return.
